note: After the revision by Constantino (1995); the original is in English. Alates, soldiers (including heads from different colonies) and workers are described. Soldier measurements: 19 soldiers from 18 colonies, head length 5.10—7.00 mm, maximum head width 4.80—6.70 mm, head height without postmentum 2.70—3.80 mm, frontal tube length 0.24—0.37 mm, left mandible length 2.70—3.10 mm, curvature 0.85—1.50 mm, left mandible M1—M2 distance 0.62—0.94 mm, left mandible width 0.77—1.04 mm, left mandible M1 length 0.18—0.35 mm, minimum postmentum width 0.79—1.09 mm, pronotum width 3.50—5.00 mm, metanotum width 3.60—5.70 mm, hind tibia length 4.80—6.80 mm. The species is widespread and variable, hence the broad measurement ranges. OCR punctuation of the kind '5.10-7,00' has been corrected.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alates indistinguishable from S. cearensis and very similar to S. aculeosus, S. spinosus, S. chaquimayensis and S. tanygnathus; S. cearensis has a wider pronotum and a larger fontanelle, S. spinosus and S. chaquimayensis have longer and more numerous hairs on the head, and S. tanygnathus is compared under that species.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Compound eyes small, less than 1/4 of the head width without the eyes; ocelli small; fontanelle round and large. Antennae 20-segmented. Anterior corners of the pronotum angular with an acute projection; lateral margins slightly S-shaped, nearly parallel on the anterior half. Wings dark and relatively short; apex of the mediana and cubitus distinct. Head capsule with scattered, very short hairs, sometimes almost invisible; postclypeus with 6—8 short hairs; outer margin of the pronotum hairy, the surface with only a few scattered hairs; posterior margins of the abdominal tergites with very short hairs.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule short, head length and width subequal; sides nearly parallel or slightly contracted anteriorly; posterior margin of the head nearly round or weakly trilobate. Frontal tube prominent and broad, the pore not visible in dorsal view. Labrum short, length and width subequal.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Worker: head capsule covered with numerous short, straight setae; postclypeus with about 12 setae; fontanelle large and round; spines of the thoracic nota well developed. Antennae 20-segmented. Mandibular molar plate rather narrow, the basal notch forming an obtuse angle. The hind gut is described in detail by Kovoor (1969).
